name: Nicol Bolas
description: Nicol Bolas is an ancient elder dragon and planeswalker, a schemer who poses a greater threat to the Multiverse than almost any other creature and who ruled Amonkhet as the God-Pharaoh.

bio.text: He became Ugin's rival and killed him, first in the Meditation Realm and then on Tarkir.

bio.text: He broke Sarkhan Vol's will and made him a servant, sent him to the Eye of Ugin, and manipulated Jace, Chandra and Sarkhan into reactivating the Eye and releasing the Eldrazi.

bio.text: Sixty years before the Gatewatch arrived, he came to Amonkhet, destroyed its mortals, subdued and corrupted its gods and set up the Trials, and he returned as the God-Pharaoh to burn Naktamun.

bio.text: He defeated the Gatewatch on Amonkhet, nearly destroying Jace's mind, driving off Gideon, Chandra and Nissa, and winning Liliana over, then declared the planar bridge and his army ready.

bio.text: He then hired Vraska to retrieve an item from Orazca and pursued Azor's plan to imprison him, defeating Ugin on Tarkir, while Jace and Vraska plotted to sabotage him.

citations.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.
