timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls Bolas sending him to the Eye of Ugin to watch, and being left blinded and sleeping.
timeline.quote: Bolas sent me to the Eye. He told me to wait.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Bolas treated him as a mere pawn and dismissed him as a dragon's toy.
timeline.quote: I am dismissed, a dragon's toy, tossed aside and useless.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls the name Ugin as the dragon he should have heeded, and hears a voice telling him to find the doorway.
timeline.quote: The world remembers what its people have forgotten.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset reads the Annals in the stronghold's depths, learning of clans working together against the dragons and of Ugin and Bolas, but cannot decipher Ugin's runes.
timeline.quote: I learned that a dragon named Ugin was connected to Tarkir in ways the khans couldn't comprehend, and that some had claimed Ugin was gone, but not dead.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas and Ugin, long-time rivals, finally clash in the sky above Tarkir, and Sarkhan arrives to watch.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas and Ugin—two of the most powerful Planeswalkers the Multiverse has ever known—finally clashed in the sky above Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova reveals that a great golden dragon appeared in her vision and asked her to chart the storms so that he could find and kill Ugin.
timeline.quote: He told me that if I showed him the way to the spirit dragon's lair…he would kill Ugin.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the dragon in her vision was Bolas, already on Tarkir in the past.
timeline.quote: Bolas was already here!

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova confesses that she helped a malevolent dragon spirit attack Ugin in hopes of ending the storms.
timeline.quote: I saw that the storms would cease if I helped a malevolent dragon spirit kill the great Ugin.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explodes from the ruins, recognizes Sorin, and says he was saved after Bolas attacked him using his own dragons.
timeline.quote: He thought me his rival for power, and attacked me. Used my own dragons against me.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains his history: Ugin's spirit whispered to him, Bolas sent him to the Eye, and he later traveled back in time to save Ugin.
timeline.quote: When I stepped through I traveled back, before the dragons died, and tipped the scales of history.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan names Bolas as the one who sent him to the Eye to release the Eldrazi, and Ugin contains him briefly in a sphere of force before releasing him.
timeline.quote: He wanted it opened, the devourers released. He never told me why.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Sarkhan she follows a vision given by Bolas, and Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies off.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies away.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Bolas strikes down Ugin, Sarkhan wraps Ugin in a hedron cocoon, and is whisked back to an altered present; the dragon tempests intensify.
timeline.quote: Bolas strikes Ugin down as Sarkhan tumbles into the snow.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he knows Jace was one of three planeswalkers who opened the Eye, manipulated by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: You, a pyromancer, and a dragonspeaker. Planeswalkers all. You opened the Eye.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: In Emrakul's presence Liliana wonders whether seeking not to die was the wrong goal, and recalls Josu, Bolas and the Chain Veil as her worst moments.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had been pursuing the wrong goal

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls working for Bolas and turning Jace against Tezzeret, and Jace wrecking Tezzeret's mind on Ravnica four years ago.
timeline.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Tezzeret is working for Bolas to pay a debt.
timeline.quote: "Oh," Liliana breathed. "Oh. You're here for Bolas."

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana pins Tezzeret under her heel and forces him to reveal Bolas is on Amonkhet, home of the demon Razaketh.
timeline.quote: "Razaketh," he gasped.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana's briefing on Tezzeret and Amonkhet leads the Gatewatch to discuss stopping Bolas, whom Liliana says controls and may have created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: "Bolas controls the place completely. As far as I know, he created it."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals he once defeated Bolas in the Maelstrom, warns against going to Amonkhet and asks them to gather allies first.
timeline.quote: "Give me time to get some of those friends together.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes there are gods on Amonkhet, in the world of Bolas.
timeline.quote: There are gods on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra reveals the God-Pharaoh's return and the Hours begin when the sun rests between the horns, any day now.
timeline.quote: "The Hours will begin when the sun rests between the horns. I'd estimate any day now."

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: In an old alley, Nissa sees carved glyphs showing eight gods and a recently added horns sigil, concluding Bolas corrupted rather than created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas didn't create this world , she realized, he corrupted it.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and they resolve to learn what he changed and to speak with Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas must have come and gone only a few decades ago.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana lounges in a shaded tent, served by mummies, thinking of her hunt for Razaketh and of Nicol Bolas, who brokered her demonic contracts.
timeline.quote: Razaketh would make three.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana says they have met the Horned One, and Temmet has the mummies choke her in rage.
timeline.quote: We've met him, actually,

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Seeing through the illusions, Nissa witnesses a vision of a dark snake's shadow swearing to drain every world, starting with Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: For what I require, I would drain every world.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa recognizes that Kefnet is made of corrupted leylines, and weaves a spell that adds a new fiber of mana to them, altering him so he no longer wants to destroy her.
timeline.quote: She pulled it, and added a new fiber of mana to its mix.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon tears the cartouche from his neck, resolving to strike down Bolas.
timeline.quote: I tore the cartouche from my neck, dropping it on the ground before me.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In a ruined shrine they find the word Trespasser freshly carved beneath the God-Pharaoh's symbol.
timeline.quote: Trespasser.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut finds a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument and sees the God-Pharaoh named Trespasser.
timeline.quote: The walls of the shadowed chamber spoke of the God-Pharaoh's first arrival on Amonkhet

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut realizes that the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser who caused the calamity rather than saving the plane, and resolves to warn everyone.
timeline.quote: He caused it.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut dares to ask whether Hazoret herself is mistaken and appeals to the god of compassion she once was before the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: Any tiny sliver of a memory of that time before the God-Pharaoh?

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Sixty years earlier, the dragon arrives from another world with only days of magic left to put his plan in motion.
timeline.quote: He had days.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The gods of Amonkhet fight the dragon outside the Hekma, and Oketra's arrows fail to harm him.
timeline.quote: The arrow hit the dragon's side, and he laughed.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon fractures Kefnet's mind in two, and Kefnet falls.
timeline.quote: The dragon tipped his chin and fractured Kefnet's mind in two.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: With Kefnet down, the Hekma wavers and the dragon bursts through it.
timeline.quote: the hole widened enough for the dragon to burst through.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon, protected by shifting half a step from reality, lands on the tallest tower and channels a spell.
timeline.quote: The dragon landed atop the tallest tower, closed his eyes, and began to channel a spell.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon dissipates every mortal old enough to walk, leaving only infants and the gods in shock.
timeline.quote: every mortal old enough to walk dissipated into the sky.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and Oketra flee to a mausoleum and gather the orphaned children as the dragon follows.
timeline.quote: Hazoret began gently picking up as many children as she could.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon breaks the seal and blanks the minds of Hazoret and Oketra, who fall defeated.
timeline.quote: the minds of the two gods went utterly blank.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon takes three gods for himself and corrupts the leylines of the remaining gods to bind them to him and to forget their origins.
timeline.quote: he returned to the surface and took three of the gods for his own.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon raises the enchanted dead as caretakers and repurposes an elite sacrificial ceremony into the endless Trials, setting the second sun to move on his schedule.
timeline.quote: He spelled the second sun to move as he was ready

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon builds a throne and a horned monument, and plants a promise of his return in the gods and the people.
timeline.quote: he made a promise to return

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Decades later, the second sun settles between the horns and the dragon comes to collect his hoard.
timeline.quote: The time had come for the dragon to return to collect his hoard.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The story recounts the God-Pharaoh's creation myth, in which he forged five gods and set the Trials and the second sun.
timeline.quote: And so the great God-Pharaoh forged the gods.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: As the poison unbinds Bolas's magic, Rhonas remembers the true history of the dragon, the corrupted gods, and the original eight.
timeline.quote: The great lie of the God-Pharaoh.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas names Nicol Bolas with his dying breath and recognizes the scorpion god as one of his corrupted brothers.
timeline.quote: This god was once one of the original eight

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra concludes it is the absent God-Pharaoh's fault and saves two children from mummies.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh who was not here.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret burns locusts from the God-Pharaoh's throne and prays for his return.
timeline.quote: She prayed to the God-Pharaoh for his return.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A rift in the sky above the throne tears open and Nicol Bolas, the golden God-Pharaoh, emerges.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh had arrived.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The God-Pharaoh smiles at the destruction and unleashes black flames that consume the cheering mortals.
timeline.quote: a deluge of black flames streaked down, consuming everything it touched.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret shields the mortals with sand and flame and realizes the God-Pharaoh brings only destruction.
timeline.quote: He rains destruction upon his people, his children.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu kneels, hails Nicol Bolas by name and declares her servitude, revealing she has served him and culled dissenters.
timeline.quote: I have culled dissenters from all the crops

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas commands Bontu to kill her sister, and Bontu blasts Hazoret with dark energy.
timeline.quote: Kill your sister.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and she remembers Bolas's deception.
timeline.quote: And suddenly, Hazoret remembered everything.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Hazoret and drops her at Bolas's feet, then Bolas blasts Bontu, calling her usefulness ended.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised one claw—and blasted Bontu with a bolt of dark energy.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas leaves to find the scarab god as undead swarm and drag down Bontu.
timeline.quote: flying toward the gate and the waiting scarab god.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit sees the dragon God-Pharaoh and realizes he is no impostor but the being they served.
timeline.quote: This dragon is not an impostor. This dragon is our God-Pharaoh.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit hurls Oketra's spear at the dragon, but he freezes it and it snaps; he calls her useful only in a different world and walks away.
timeline.quote: you might have been useful.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas emerges from a void in the sky and rains black fire on the city and its cheering mortals.
timeline.quote: That was when the dragon raised his hands, and black fire fell from the skies.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut tells the survivors that the God-Pharaoh is a lie and a trespasser, and Masikah doubts her.
timeline.quote: He is a trespasser, an interloper from another world.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert as Bolas flies above, and Djeru and the survivors kneel to her.
timeline.quote: we must simply endure, persist, survive

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas flies toward the five waiting planeswalkers and reflects on his decades of preparation on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: At the edges of the plaza, five planeswalkers stood arrayed against him

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas lands and roars, judging the Gatewatch's simple kill-the-dragon plan.
timeline.quote: They had chosen kill the dragon .

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas swats Gideon against a wall with his tail while ignoring the other attacks.
timeline.quote: Gideon sailed into a thick brick wall lining one side of the plaza.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace attacks Bolas's mind but is lured into a trap and the dragon squeezes his mind.
timeline.quote: The obsidian shield disappeared, and Jace fell unexpectedly into Nicol Bolas's mind.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana, shaken by Jace's scream, is torn between the Chain Veil's urging and the Raven Man's counsel as Bolas taunts her.
timeline.quote: Yes, use us. Unleash your full power

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers to teach Liliana to master the Chain Veil and tells her to go if she wants to live.
timeline.quote: I can help you unlock its power, Liliana.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
timeline.quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra drives Bolas back with white fire for the first time, but he dismisses her as a child.
timeline.quote: he was forced backward for the first time in the fight

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa raises spurs and a giant earth elemental against Bolas, but he crushes Chandra in his claw and shatters her defenses.
timeline.quote: He swooped in and grabbed her in a huge claw.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas strangles Nissa with necrotic tendrils, and she tells Chandra to flee; Chandra planeswalks away injured.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away in a fiery blaze

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas corrupts the leylines Nissa controls, and Gideon's interruption lets her flee the plane.
timeline.quote: She used Gideon's interruption to flee from this dead husk of a world.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas grabs Gideon and pierces his shield and shoulder with a talon, then offers him the choice to stay and die or leave and live.
timeline.quote: the shield parted like melted butter

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives late, and Bolas sends him to fetch Ral Zarek, saying the battle was better than blood.
timeline.quote: Go and tell Ral Zarek to come to me.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas roars, declaring the planar bridge his and the army ready, and steps openly out of the shadows.
timeline.quote: was finally taking his first steps, visibly and openly.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, reading her mind and offering to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari.
timeline.quote: I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
timeline.quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska accepts, and Bolas bars her from double-crossing him.
timeline.quote: I accept your terms,

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas gives Vraska the thaumatic compass and implants a spell to call his associate and knowledge of sailing.
timeline.quote: It is the thaumatic compass,

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the plan was to imprison Nicol Bolas, and Jace remembers him.
timeline.quote: Our intention was to imprison Nicol Bolas

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks why Bolas wants a planeswalker prison and Jace says she needs to know who she works for.
timeline.quote: you need to know who you're working for.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Azor he has a plan to free the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Together we will rid the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas interrogates an elf bureaucrat about the lawbringer and learns of Azor.
timeline.quote: The sphinx was called Azor.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: On another plane Bolas absorbs a lawmage's mind, learning of the plot and killing her.
timeline.quote: listening to him and the Spirit Dragon plot the end of the True Evil

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas appears before Ugin on Tarkir, having followed Azor's clues.
timeline.quote: when his nemesis appeared before him

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas mocks Azor's statues as the reason he was found.
timeline.quote: Your idiot cat is too fond of statues of himself,

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas overpowers Ugin with a swarm of dragon eyes and attackers.
timeline.quote: The Spirit Dragon tried to escape, but was caught in a tempest of fire and claws.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas planeswalks away, believing he has won.
timeline.quote: And Nicol Bolas planeswalked away, never to return, for he had won.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska share everything they know about Bolas.
timeline.quote: Jace told Vraska everything he knew about Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: They deduce Bolas made a transportable army of Eternals and the Sun would trap anyone who arrives.
timeline.quote: He made an army he could transport across the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace shows Vraska his memory of breaking into Bolas's mind on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: He was trying to break into Nicol Bolas's mind.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace saw that Ravnica was Bolas's goal.
timeline.quote: Ravnica was writ large upon the ambition in Nicol Bolas's mind.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas scrambles Jace's memories, but a trap Jace's mind carried sends him to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a part of Jace's mind propelled him from Amonkhet to Ixalan.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Bolas wants her help to unleash an army on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: He wants to unleash an army.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace recognizes the plan is to betray Bolas.
timeline.quote: You want to betray Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska lays out the plan to accept Bolas's offer of guild leader and wait until Jace restores her memories.
timeline.quote: He promised me the title of guild leader.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds Bolas's letter summoning her to the meditation plane.
timeline.quote: MEDITATION PLANE

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska meets Nicol Bolas on the meditation plane.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas was waiting for her.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas scours Vraska's mind and replays her Ixalan memories.
timeline.quote: He peered into each corner of her memories of Ixalan and replayed them all in the blink of an eye.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska's memory shows a sphinx rampaging through Orazca, which Bolas accepts as true.
timeline.quote: watching as a sphinx rampaged through Orazca . . .

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas rewards Vraska with a kingdom of her own design.
timeline.quote: You have earned a kingdom of your own design.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas's note names her guildleader and gives a location for Jarad.
timeline.quote: HE IS ALONE AND IMPRISONED HERE

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, wounded in the shoulder, admits the battle against Bolas did not go to plan.
timeline.quote: The second thing Gideon noticed was the hole in his shoulder and its piercing pain.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani scolds Gideon and Liliana for going to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: You should not have gone to Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra explains she needs more power to fight Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: I need more power to fight Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks onto the moving Weatherlight and warns that Bolas is preparing a trap for planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Ajani wanted us to meet and regroup, but Bolas is preparing a trap for Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals he fought Bolas long ago and lost, and says he took his spark back to join the fight; Karn says he will consider the invitation.
timeline.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas reveals that Liliana's pact defaults to its broker, himself, when her demons die, and he threatens that disobedience will kill her.
timeline.quote: You seem unaware that with your demons dead, your contract defaults to its broker.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas planeswalks away and Liliana follows, resolved to find an escape while staying alive.
timeline.quote: Sick at heart, bound like a prisoner to a new incarnation of a fate she had schemed so long to cheat, Liliana followed in his wake.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The last egg-stone unfurls into twin dragons, Nicol and Ugin, who crash through the canopy; Nicol is pinned by a tree trunk.
timeline.quote: You're Nicol, aren't you? That's your name.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Hunters work together to net and kill Merrevia Sal while Nicol, pinned, wants to help but Ugin holds him back.
timeline.quote: Yet still she struggles, still she fights because she is a dragon, and dragons never bow before lesser creatures.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin clamps Nicol's muzzle to hush him as Merrevia is hunted into the trees and dies.
timeline.quote: Ugin clamps talons over his muzzle, smothering him.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol is freed and finds the clearing too late; he wants revenge but Ugin urges finding their siblings first.
timeline.quote: We must find the others first. Safety in numbers, as the hunters had.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol rips off a dog's head and flies awkwardly to the peak with Ugin.
timeline.quote: He leaps forward onto the lead dog and rips its head off with a single bite.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: From the peak Nicol sees the bodies of weak dragons and decides being the hunter is better, while Ugin stares at the sky and asks where they came from.
timeline.quote: Dying isn't wonderful. It's bad. But being the hunter: that's a better thing.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback in Ugin's words: he and Nicol learn that no creature is safe after witnessing their sister's death and set out to find their siblings.
timeline.quote: We witnessed the death of a sister, and in this way, we learned that no creature is safe.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol insists they should have interfered to stop the hunters and wants to learn how to destroy them.
timeline.quote: I want to know who those hunters are, and where they come from, and how we can destroy them.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins meet Chromium Rhuell by a lake, who dismisses them and sends them to Palladia-Mors.
timeline.quote: But for now, go away, little ones.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Palladia-Mors scorns the twins as runts and flings a corpse at them.
timeline.quote: You're so small, the two of you. Little runts.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin sees nothing wasted in the cycle of life and death, while Nicol wants to kill something.
timeline.quote: I want to kill something,

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins spend years perfecting tandem hunting, and meet Vaevictis Asmadi's territory.
timeline.quote: We spent years, as you Jeskai would measure the span of days, perfecting various techniques for hunting in tandem.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins find Arcades Sabboth ruling a human settlement.
timeline.quote: To our surprise our sibling Arcades Sabboth had taken up residence inside the great ring wall.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol burns a tower and soldiers when humans shoot at the twins, and Arcades slams into him.
timeline.quote: His blast of fire breath scorched along the highest tower and its adjoining wall walk.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol takes the name Nicol Bolas and the twins are admitted to the colony as Arcades's guests.
timeline.quote: I am Nicol Bolas,

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins live for years in the colony, Ugin befriending the holy elder Te Ju Ki.
timeline.quote: I poked my snout into everything, and made particular friends with an old holy elder named Te Ju Ki

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: one man stabs his brother in a sudden quarrel after years of peace, and Nicol watches with satisfaction.
timeline.quote: Nicol lounged there, stretched along the ridgeline, watching the scene with an avid gaze.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol tells Ugin he has found a better way to avenge their sister and flies off without farewells.
timeline.quote: I have discovered a better way to get revenge.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova asks Tae Jin to continue Ugin's story, especially about Bolas.
timeline.quote: Tell me more about Ugin. And about Bolas.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin finds Vaevictis Asmadi and his siblings chasing Nicol while burning human settlements.
timeline.quote: They were chasing a dragon.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin frightens Vaevictis off with spun globes of light so Nicol can escape.
timeline.quote: So, I reached into my tiny arsenal of magical tricks and spun a pair of transparent, feather-light globes out of the nexus of colors and into the air.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol reunites with Ugin and mocks Te Ju Ki, claiming no human can be as wise as the youngest dragon.
timeline.quote: No human, however old, can ever be as wise as the youngest dragon

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol tells Ugin of other lands across the ocean and refuses to consider that other dragons may be older.
timeline.quote: We are the first, after all, and thus the most powerful.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Palladia-Mors steals the twins' kills and warns them that humans near the birth mountain think they are dragon hunters.
timeline.quote: Those humans have gotten above themselves and think they are dragon hunters.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins reach the birth mountain and find human settlements with dragon skulls and carved gates showing dragons being killed.
timeline.quote: They have turned our sister into an ornament!

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: humans fire poisoned bolts, wounding Ugin, and fight to bathe in his fallen blood.
timeline.quote: Although Nicol twisted out of their way, my left rear claw was cut by a glancing blow.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin lands on the mountain's rim and Nicol vows to avenge their sister, claiming a cunning plan that needs no killing.
timeline.quote: I have a plan, a very cunning plan, because I have taught myself to do something no one else can do.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin and Nicol wait on the birth mountain overnight and see a lone traveler who proves to be Chromium Rhuell in human form.
timeline.quote: who appeared outwardly as a pregnant human except for the way his eyes shone like sapphires

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell describes the dragon-killing chief and his heirs and proposes destroying them; Nicol twists his words.
timeline.quote: My recommendation is that we destroy the chief, his heirs, and his acolytes, burn all the temples, and salt the fields.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell, enraged by Nicol's twisting of words, reveals his true dragon form, belittles Nicol as the least of them, and flies away.
timeline.quote: You are the least of us, last fallen, not even a whole dragon but only half of one, bound as you are to Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The twins watch the chief's procession and temple; Ugin hears whispers about the heirs' rivalry.
timeline.quote: She intends to outlast you and have you throttled when he dies.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol identifies the chief's attendants as two of his four heirs and says it will be easy.
timeline.quote: Those two who attend him so assiduously are two of his heirs.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol kills a young messenger to stop word reaching the other heirs.
timeline.quote: he swooped down, caught up the youth in his claws and, as the young human screamed and struggled, bit off his head.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol whispers into the mind of the chief's son at a lakeside settlement, persuading him to march against the other heirs and kill his father.
timeline.quote: It could be your measure. If you march against the other heirs.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol marks the longhouse ridge and the son's warriors march off; Nicol explains humans are easy to manipulate through hate, envy and fear.
timeline.quote: Humans are riddled with hate and envy and fear and greed.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The chief's son seizes the central settlement, Nicol lures the other two heirs into a battle and burns the temple.
timeline.quote: Nicol flew down to the unguarded temple and burned it and its acolytes to the ground.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol deposits the old chief in the courtyard of his second wife, who has been whispered into rebellion; she kills him.
timeline.quote: She stabbed him once, twice, and thrice, and had his bloody, bloated body thrown into the stinking refuse of a latrine.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The son and the second wife are wed, then kill each other in a blood oath, and Nicol proclaims himself the humans' true leader.
timeline.quote: I rule you now. I am your true leader. Bow before me.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin realizes Nicol caused the earlier murder and plans to manipulate his mind too, and he feels his twin's betrayal.
timeline.quote: He wanted to use me for his own ends, because he had never truly cared for me at all.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova reveals Bolas killed Ugin and that she was used as a tool, and that hedrons cast by Sarkhan Vol preserved some essence of Ugin.
timeline.quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: In the story, the young dragon king Nicol sets the human heirs against each other, loses his brother Ugin to a blast of sorcery, and rules as a just king.
timeline.quote: In the course of the war, his brother was swept away into nothingness by a blast of human sorcery

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Dragons descended from Vaevictis raid the kingdom's settlements, and the king resolves to fight them with his army and venom-laced weapons.
timeline.quote: We are the descendants of Vaevictis Asmadi and may raid where we wish!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king's army slaughters seven of Vaevictis's descendants with ballistae and sorcery but one escapes.
timeline.quote: It was a rout. A slaughter.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king pursues the survivor across the plains and meets Vaevictis, Lividus, Ravus and Rubra, who drop the dead dragon onto the army.
timeline.quote: The corpse hit hard, instantly crushing an entire company of slingers.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king's ballistae wound Rubra with a venom bolt, but the army is routed by Vaevictis's fire.
timeline.quote: Rubra took a bolt to the eye.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king retreats into a canyon with a third of his army and plans a trap, thinking of Ugin and his search for a disintegration spell.
timeline.quote: For generations he had toiled in concert with his academy of sorcerers to recover or devise a magic that could replicate Ugin's disappearance.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The sorcerers' disintegration spell kills Ravus, and Lividus destroys the ballistae.
timeline.quote: Ravus splintered like rock heated until it explodes.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol uses mind touch on Lividus to turn him against Vaevictis and sets the two brothers against each other.
timeline.quote: He pressed the venom-tipped spear of his sharp mind deep into Lividus's simmering rancor.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Vaevictis and Lividus fight each other as Nicol retreats and kills his own witnesses.
timeline.quote: Traitor! Backstabber!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol spreads lies among the descendants of Vaevictis's brothers and Palladia-Mors, igniting clan wars among the dragons.
timeline.quote: The ease with which the gullible could be turned to his purpose was surprisingly pleasurable.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Dragons fight across the world and Arcades Sabboth joins the war after hearing whispers of wisdom.
timeline.quote: threw his might into the great war as he listened to the whispers of wisdom that brushed through his mind

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin shifts back to Dominaria and finds the birth mountain now holds a city and temple with curved horns, which tells him Nicol rules there.
timeline.quote: He recognizes the shape of the curved horns.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin travels among many planes, then decides to find Nicol again, having mastered planeswalking.
timeline.quote: By now, he has mastered planeswalking.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin appears between the warring armies of Nicol and Arcades on Jamuraa and demands they stop.
timeline.quote: Nicol! Arcades! You must put a stop to this! It's wrong!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol, thinking Ugin dead, blasts him with fire before Ugin convinces him; Nicol leaves his army to take Ugin to his domain.
timeline.quote: It will be. Come see what I have accomplished. Come, Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin confronts Nicol atop the birth mountain about his mind-manipulation and the pointlessness of his conquests.
timeline.quote: You tried to influence me with that trick of the mind.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he is a planeswalker, and Nicol asks to be taught.
timeline.quote: I am a Planeswalker now.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin cannot explain the spark; Nicol calls him a liar and a coward, and Ugin leaves in fury and grief.
timeline.quote: You can't tell me, can you?

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva sees the false Mevra gliding down the path with feet off the ground and calls her out.
timeline.quote: You aren't Mevra. You're no kin of mine.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: The false Mevra turns inside out and reveals herself as a gigantic horned dragon, Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: A dragon unfolded out of the illusion, so magnificent a creature that the memory of Atarka's might seemed paltry in comparison.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas says he wants Ugin, admits he killed him once before, and tries to enlist Naiva to destroy him for all eternity.
timeline.quote: That's what I thought the first time I killed him, but he wasn't dead after all.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers Naiva rule of the world if she tells him where Ugin is, and Naiva asks why he hates his twin.
timeline.quote: Why do you hate Ugin? He's your twin.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas denies that Ugin is his twin, calling it a story Ugin spread to share his glory.
timeline.quote: That's just a story he put about, trying to grab for a share of my glory and my triumph.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva realizes Bolas does not know where Ugin's body lies and tries to keep him distracted to protect Baishya.
timeline.quote: Somehow, amazingly, this powerful dragon did not know Ugin's body lay concealed beneath the hedrons.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva challenges Bolas that he was born together with Ugin, and he roars in anger and asks who told her.
timeline.quote: Of course that's not right! Who told you that?

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas begins his account, claiming he woke first and woke Ugin, who flew only because he taught him.
timeline.quote: In this way he discovered flight or, I should say, I taught him that flight is what we dragons are made for.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva interrupts to say there were eight dragons, and Bolas swats a foreclaw down to knock her over.
timeline.quote: Do not interrupt me again!

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he alone dared to land on the ground and named the world Dominaria.
timeline.quote: So, I named our home Dominaria, because I claimed its song for myself.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he avenged his sister's death on the humans while Ugin lost his nerve, then Ugin fled, vanishing.
timeline.quote: And so, he fled. He vanished, there one moment and then as if with the blink of the eye and a ripple through the air . . . GONE.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he killed the sorcerers around him and founded academies, then fought wars with his siblings until Arcades retreated and Ugin returned in the middle of the final battle.
timeline.quote: One day, when I had finally driven that stubborn tyrant Arcades into retreat, Ugin returned.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas says Ugin mocked him atop the birth mountain and vanished, and Bolas felt rage and envy.
timeline.quote: In a ripple of warm wind, he was gone.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas says a spark of rage ignited him and he became a planeswalker, arriving at a mirror sea.
timeline.quote: With my next breath, I comprehended the whole: I had become a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he visited hundreds of worlds, found no other planeswalker, and returned home to share this with Ugin.
timeline.quote: I was the first among all sapient creatures to discover the possibility of traveling between planes.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas visits Arcades's kingdom, hears he last saw Ugin long ago, and plants doubts in his mind about his subjects.
timeline.quote: I insinuated a worm of doubt in his haughty mind

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he found Ugin floating in the Meditation Realm and that Ugin attacked him, leading to a long struggle across the planes.
timeline.quote: He attacked, viciously and without warning, all raw fury and malignant resentment.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he killed Ugin in the Meditation Realm in self-defense, and the shockwaves hurled him back to Dominaria on Madara.
timeline.quote: There, purely in self-defense, I killed him.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas threatens Naiva, tells her Ugin plagued him later with a plan to trap him on Ixalan, and learns she says Ugin's bones lie beneath the hedrons.
timeline.quote: He has plagued me ever since, most recently with a misbegotten plan to trap me on Ixalan by means of a magical artifact.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas preys on Naiva's resentments toward Baishya and offers to make her the great hunter and leader.
timeline.quote: You could finally become the great hunter and leader you deserve to be.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas threatens to destroy Tarkir unless Naiva brings Yasova to him, and promises to clear her enemies.
timeline.quote: All you need do is bring me Yasova. Now.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva tells Bolas that Yasova is hiding right there.
timeline.quote: She's here. Right here. Hiding.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas killed Ugin and uses mind touch, and that she will be taken because he threatened Tarkir.
timeline.quote: The dragon who killed Ugin has returned.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova confesses she helped Bolas track Ugin and cast a spell that turned fledgling dragons against him, after being promised an end to dragons.
timeline.quote: I helped Bolas track down Ugin because he promised me an end to dragons on Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin, in the Meditation Realm, regrets that Nicol was not overjoyed at his return and wonders whether his departure was his fault.
timeline.quote: Nicol had succumbed to the worst in himself

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas attacks Ugin in the Meditation Realm, accusing him of hoarding the planes' knowledge and abandoning him.
timeline.quote: You hoarded the knowledge of the planes to yourself.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin flees through Zendikar, Kephalai and Ravnica with Bolas in pursuit, wounded by his venomous magic.
timeline.quote: From bustling Kephalai to growing Ravnica and on and on, he flees with Nicol breathing down his neck

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin realizes Nicol will never stop unless he thinks him dead, and accepts death in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: With a sigh, Ugin accepts his death. He lets go.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas kills Ugin, who falls into the waters; the cataclysm drains the realm and flings Bolas to Madara.
timeline.quote: With a mighty splash, Ugin falls into the still waters.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas, as god-emperor, sets two curved horns over the Meditation Realm to mark his triumph.
timeline.quote: Here, he erects two gigantic curved horns so they emerge from the waters

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas arrives on Tarkir and, turning the dragons against their progenitor, kills Ugin, who falls and carves the canyon.
timeline.quote: Bolas turns the dragons of Tarkir against their own progenitor

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova and Baishya face Bolas, taunting him that he came back to confirm Ugin was dead.
timeline.quote: You came back to see if he was really dead.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas threatens to devastate Tarkir and orders Naiva to kill Yasova, but Naiva resists in the hedron.
timeline.quote: Do it, Naiva. I command you! Kill her, and I will grant you all that you desire

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Bolas that the Immortal Sun will trap him and Baishya says they hear the artifact; Bolas, fearing the bluff may be true, strikes the canyon and flees.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun is pointed here, at this very spot on Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
timeline.quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the Hall of Treasures Vivien sees hundreds of taxidermied extinct species and wants to see it all gone, understanding Bolas for a moment.
timeline.quote: For one terrible moment, the Planeswalker could understand Nicol Bolas, the death of Skalla, the end of everything she'd known and loved.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: The baron tortures Vivien repeatedly with boiling-blood magic and blades, and nuns heal her each time; Vivien resists, having already been scarred by Bolas's destruction of Skalla.
timeline.quote: Each time he asked his questions, the baron's magic reached out, found the blood coursing through Vivien's body, and brought it to boil.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Left alone, Vivien relives the death of Skalla and Nicol Bolas rising into the burning sky, even in her dreams.
timeline.quote: When Vivien slumbered, she dreamed Skalla.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien decides to harness dragons to learn the secret of destroying Nicol Bolas, and settles on luring a Shivan dragon.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas wasn't the only dragon in the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Rat and Teyo arrive at Tenth District Plaza and find a new obelisk and pyramid crowned with dragon statues.
timeline.quote: Sometime—sometime very recently—it had risen out of the ground, displacing buildings and gardens and whatever else used to be there.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: A giant portal opens and splits the Embassy of the Guildpact, killing bystanders, and Bolas gloats from his pyramid.
timeline.quote: A gigantic portal—easily fifty yards tall—had opened up behind us, instantly decimating the Embassy of the Guildpact, sheering it right in half.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Four God-Eternals emerge from the portal over Tenth District Plaza, and Samut identifies them as her plane's gods, now Bolas's servants.
timeline.quote: They are our gods,

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The God-Eternals tear apart Vitu-Ghazi, and Domri cheers and announces the Gruul will join the dragon.
timeline.quote: We're joining the dragon!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out five problems: the Beacon, the Immortal Sun, the Planar Bridge, Liliana Vess, and Bolas himself.
timeline.quote: We face a number of problems. Five to be exact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Bolas blasts Rakdos back, but Gideon leaps over and strikes; Blackblade shatters against Bolas's brow.
timeline.quote: Blackblade shattered against Nicol Bolas's invincible brow.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Liliana turns the Eternals against Bolas, switching sides.
timeline.quote: I knew then that Miss Raven-Hair had switched sides.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet stabs Bolas with the Spear of Hazoret but is thrown aside.
timeline.quote: Hovering behind him and holding the spear was Master Niv-Mizzet

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Oketra is destroyed, and Bontu bites Bolas and harvests all his Sparks, exploding.
timeline.quote: Bontu began harvesting all the Sparks the Elderspell had granted the dragon.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Bolas disintegrates and dies, his gem dropping to the Citadel roof.
timeline.quote: I watched as Bolas began to dissolve

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace, keeping the secret that Bolas lives, plans to go to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: That the ancient, terrible dragon was still alive.

citation.work: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret and Karn argue over Karn's responsibility for New Phyrexia and Bolas's threat, and Tezzeret reveals he suggested eliminating the plane to Bolas.
timeline.quote: His first act as god-emperor would have been to obliterate New Phyrexia from existence.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The god explains that Bolas could not kill the spirit of Amonkhet's gods.
timeline.quote: Bolas thought he had strangled our spirit within his claws, but what do you see around you?

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The realm reveals Ugin and a chained dragon together.
timeline.quote: revealing two figures that Narset would have known even in death

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin warns them away, and Bolas, who has lost his memories, says he recognizes the three and calls Jace an accomplice.
timeline.quote: That you, perhaps, were an accomplice

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that he has made the realm a prison for his brother, to be kept until Bolas dies millennia from now.
timeline.quote: So, I have made this our prison

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Bolas learns his name from Elspeth's argument and begins to remember.
timeline.quote: Is that my name?

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he wants to reverse Phyrexia's damage and control the realm; Elspeth attacks him and Narset protects her.
timeline.quote: What if I say that I can reverse everything?

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Bolas laughs as his fetters come undone and he and Ugin vanish into the nothing as the Meditation Realm burns away.
timeline.quote: Bolas and Ugin winking out of existence, eaten by the nothing, dead now, perhaps.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin admits he has failed to keep his brother and that Bolas is free.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas, I am afraid, is free.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Jace had let Bolas be captured by Ugin and then Bolas escaped through an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: So Bolas escaped.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself against Nicol Bolas to save Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: he sacrificed himself to save Liliana Vess

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas, who planned the convergence all along, came to Alara to feed on its mana and restore its lost power in one massive ritual.
timeline.quote: He came to Alara to feed on its rich mana and, in one massive ritual, restore its lost power as part of his multiplanar plan.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The benevolent God-Pharaoh is revealed to be Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: is actually Nicol Bolas, the malevolent dragon Planeswalker whose schemes reach far beyond this plane.

citation.text: "Amonkhet". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas's machinations touch countless planes, with plots that sometimes lie dormant for decades before coming to fruition.
timeline.quote: the seeds of his elaborate plots sometimes lie dormant for decades before they come to fruition.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels from plane to plane seeking a dragon to dedicate his life to, and on Jund declares fealty to Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: There, he declared his fealty to the dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Disillusioned by Bolas, Sarkhan falls into madness and is led back to Tarkir by a voice he believes is Ugin's.
timeline.quote: Disillusioned by his servitude to the villainous, conniving, woefully undragonlike Bolas, Sarkhan fell into madness.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
